content: Simulate a moderately dense debris flow with shear-thinning non-Newtonian material. A long, open-top rectangular tank that's 100 units long, 20 units wide, and 40 units tall. At one end of the tank, there's a block of debris sitting on the floor — it's 15 units long, fills the full 20-unit width, and stands 30 units tall. Way down at the other end of the tank, about 80 units from where the debris starts, there's a small solid obstacle sitting on the floor. It's a thin slab — only 2 units thick — that's 14 units wide and 10 units tall. It's positioned slightly inward from the side walls, centered across the width of the tank. Use debris density of 1700 kg/m^3, initial particle spacing dp = 0.5 m, use Symplectic step algorithm, artificial viscosity 0.1, output time interval 0.2s and run to total time 10s.

================================================================
  SIMULATION PLAN
================================================================

### Reasoning
This is a 3D case because the tank width and obstacle width/placement across the width matter. I used an open-top tank as a single wall box with face selection and 3 boundary layers, matching coefh=1.0. The debris is initialized as a 15×20×30 m fluid block at one end on the floor. The obstacle is placed from x=80 to 82 m, on the floor, centered in the 20 m width with 3 m clearance to each side wall (y=3 to 17). For a moderately dense shear-thinning debris flow at 1700 kg/m^3, I chose Herschel-Bulkley parameters with subunit flow index HBP_n=0.75, moderate consistency visco_nn=0.2, and moderate yield tau_yield=0.02. Artificial viscosity is set to the requested 0.1, output interval to 0.2 s, and total runtime to 10 s.

### Geometry XML
```xml
<geometry>
  <definition dp="0.5">
    <pointmin x="-1.0" y="-1.0" z="-1.0" />
    <pointmax x="101.0" y="21.0" z="41.0" />
  </definition>
  <commands>
    <mainlist>
      <setshapemode>dp | bound</setshapemode>
      <setdrawmode mode="full" />

      <!-- Initial debris block -->
      <setmkfluid mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>solid</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="0" z="0" />
        <size x="15" y="20" z="30" />
      </drawbox>

      <!-- Tank walls: open top, 3 boundary layers for coefh=1.0 -->
      <setmkbound mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>bottom | left | right | front | back</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="0" z="0" />
        <size x="100" y="20" z="40" />
        <layers vdp="0,1,2" />
      </drawbox>

      <!-- Thin obstacle slab near downstream end, centered across width -->
      <setmkbound mk="1" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>solid</boxfill>
        <point x="80" y="3" z="0" />
        <size x="2" y="14" z="10" />
      </drawbox>

      <shapeout file="" />
    </mainlist>
  </commands>
</geometry>
```

### Physics Parameters
  gravity_z            = -9.81
  rhop0                = 1700.0
  coefh                = 1.0
  cflnumber            = 0.2
  phase_rhop           = 1700.0
  visco_nn             = 0.2
  tau_yield            = 0.02
  HBP_m                = 20.0
  HBP_n                = 0.75
  Visco                = 0.1
  DensityDT            = 3
  DensityDTvalue       = 0.1
  TimeMax              = 10.0
  TimeOut              = 0.2
